description: Godot debug: continue, pause, step_into/over/out (returns the new location and locals), or evaluate an expression in a stopped game (process runs).

expression.description: evaluate: a Godot Expression; sees locals, self's members/methods, autoloads. Can have side effects.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for the next stop (default 10; continue 0).
